Actually Al(OH)3 dissolves in excess NaOH to give [Al(OH)4]-, but not in NH3. Zn(OH)2 dissolves in excess NH3 to give [Zn(NH3)4]2+. Mg(OH)2 does not dissolve in excess NH3 or NaOH.

Zn2+ gives white precipitate that dissolves in excess NH3. Al3+ gives white precipitate that does not dissolve in NH3 but dissolves in NaOH.
